geometry.ordering: Each shard preserves the original global planner order after filtering by the partition rule.
geometry.rationale: At v4.1 observed prefix throughput, one monolithic job cannot finish inside the six-hour job limit. Thirty-two fixed shards put about 1.09M behavioral rows in each job and leave substantial timeout margin.

original_semantics.consumption: A future separately authorized aggregate original is consumed when the first behavioral shard begins. All 32 shards belong to that one aggregate original.
original_semantics.reruns: No shard retry, matrix retry, replacement shard, replacement aggregate original, second marker chain, or rerun is permitted after behavioral execution begins.
original_semantics.missing_shard: Any missing, cancelled, timed-out, failed, or incomplete shard makes the aggregate original incomplete and non-qualifying.
original_semantics.source_binding: Every shard must bind the same exact implementation, tree, gate, review digest, authorization digest, accepted truth digests, global plan identity and aggregate run identity.

shard_evidence.shard_plan_identity: A nonbehavioral preflight must compute all 32 shard row counts and SHA-256 digests in one deterministic pass over the frozen global plan before any future execution authorization.
shard_evidence.journal: Each shard preserves its own durable row journal. The journal repair must record non-null lawful keep/bottom values exactly rather than overwriting them with UNKNOWN.
shard_evidence.preservation: Each shard artifact is uploaded with if: always(). A complete shard additionally emits a small signed-by-content summary artifact; raw journals remain separate for exact audit.

aggregate_acceptance: each shard completed_rows equals its prospectively frozen expected_shard_rows
all shard plan SHA-256 values equal the prospectively frozen per-shard identities
all shards bind the same exact reviewed source/gate/review/authorization/input identities
required_before_execution: v5 M4 and journal repair validation
fresh independent source review of the exact semantic repair
implementation and nonbehavioral validation of the 32-shard geometry and aggregation gate
fresh independent review of the exact sharded execution gate
new explicit one-time user execution authorization bound to the final exact implementation/gate
prohibited: treating this proposal as execution authority
reusing the v4.1 marker or execution branch
behavioral execution before a fresh reviewed gate and new explicit authorization
gameplay, seed generation, allocation, claim, game or outcome exposure
